Container.Name: docker-mcp
Container.Overview: Docker MCP server, bridged over HTTP with supergateway (baked into the image) so any MCP client that speaks HTTP/SSE can use it. Mounts docker.sock, which is root-equivalent on the host - only run this where you trust every client that can reach it.
Container.Requires: Mounts the Docker socket - root-equivalent access to this host.

Config.Name: Host Port 8095
Config.Description: HTTP port supergateway serves the bridged MCP endpoint on.
